overall: The Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law on its notice, but it did violate it by discussing public relations and a press release in executive session, outside any purpose. Released minutes portion and ordered compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice gave insufficient detail about the litigation executive session topic, with no description of the matter.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting this information from its notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice failed to list an open session before the executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board, therefore, did not violate the Open Meeting Law in this regard.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the Board discussed public relations strategy and a press release in executive session, which the AG found outside any executive session purpose.
allegations.key_passage: the Board's discussion of public relations strategies and of the press release was not covered by any executive session purpose.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release to the public of the portion of the July 6, 2015 executive session minutes concerning the press release, within ten days of receipt of the letter.
